title: It stops staying warm, BEWARE MAY BLOW UP!
text:
It stops staying warm, BEWARE MAY BLOW UP!. At first I got one that was shredded looking. Then the next one I received only kept heating nicely for a few weeks. Now I have to shut it on and off, or keep turning up the heat for it to stay warm. I like the blanket but it does not want to work for me. Both had the “staying warm” problem…
And BEWARE IT BLEW UP ON MY DAUGHTER!! ALMOST STARTED HER BED ON FIRE!!

product_metadata.title: greenoak Heated Electric Throw Blanket, 50“ x 62” Heating Blanket, Thick Soft Warming Plush Electric Lap Blanket Sherpa for Adults with 5-Position Timer &10 Heating Levels (Grey)
features: 【UPGRADE HEATING SETTINGS】: Compared with the electric blanket with the common 3-gear or 4-gear heating settings on the market, our heated blanket has been upgraded to 10 heating settings (86℉- 131℉), and also has five timing settings (1, 2, 4, 6, 8 hours). Whether you are old or young, you can choose the temperature setting and timing scheme that suits your needs no matter what occasion you use it.

【INTELLIGENT OVERHEAT PROTECTION】: The heating blanket has the recognized ETL authority certification and overheat protection. When you are busy with other things and forget to turn off the electric throw blanket or sleep at night and forget to set the time, once the temperature of the main body of the heated throw blanket is too high, the overheating protection will automatically trigger to turn off the heating automatically to protect the safety of you and your family.

【SUPER SOFT MATERIAL】:The heated throw uses high-quality 220gsm flannel+200gsm sherpa, which is very soft and skin friendly, thicker than ordinary cozy blanket, and warmer than ordinary blankets even without electricity. The fabric is durable and does not fall off. The diameter of the heating wire is 2.2mm, and the electric heating wire can hardly be felt during the use, which is more comfortable.

【UNIFORM HEAT DISTRIBUTION】: The electric blanket will only heat your corner or edge, which is really annoying. In this heating blanket, we have optimized the wiring arrangement and fixed it with quilting, so that the wires are evenly distributed in the amazing soft cashmere blanket, providing you with a beautiful sleep experience.

【Loveable gift】: In these cold months, what could be better than the luxurious soft electric blanket used every night? The heated blanket will be a warm gift for birthday, Mother's Day, Father's Day and Christmas. And compared with the air conditioner, using the greenoak heating blanket can save more energy. In winter, you can save more heating costs. Why not?
